column3: The issued notes consist of the Honda Auto Receivables 2026-3  Owner Trust class A-1 notes, class A-2a notes, class A-2b notes, class A-3 notes and class A-4 notes, as described on the cover page.  See “Summary of Terms—Description of the Securities—Securities  Not Offered” below.  The class A-2a notes and the class A-2b notes are referred to  in this prospectus collectively as the “class A-2 notes.” If issued, the class A-2b notes will be floating rate  notes. All other classes of offered notes will be fixed rate notes. The allocation of the principal balance between the class A-2a  notes and the class A-2b notes will be determined on the day of pricing of the notes offered hereunder, although the principal balance  of the class A-2b notes may not exceed 75% of the aggregate principal balance of the class A-2 notes. The principal balance of the  class A-2 notes may be allocated entirely to the class A-2a notes, with no principal balance allocated to the class A-2b notes, in  which case no class A-2b notes would be issued.  The class A-2b notes will initially accrue interest based on the  SOFR Rate. However, the benchmark may change in certain situations. For more information on how the benchmark is determined, you  should read “The Notes—Calculation of Floating Rate Interest” in this prospectus.  See “The Notes—Payments of Principal” in  this prospectus for more information on the allocation of the principal balance between the class A-2a notes and the class A-2b notes.  We will make the determination regarding the appropriate initial  principal balance of the notes based on, among other considerations, market conditions at the time of pricing. See “Risk  Factors—The allocation of class A-2 notes is unknown and if the principal balance of one class of such notes is small, liquidity  on such class of notes could be reduced” in this prospectus.

Any notes, or portion of any notes, retained by AHFC are not registered  under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, and are not being offered by this prospectus. AHFC will retain at least 5% (by initial  principal amount) of each of the class A-1 notes, the class A-2 notes, the class A-3 notes and the class A-4 notes and may retain  all or an additional portion of the class A-1 notes. See “Credit Risk Retention.”  If the aggregate initial principal amount of notes is $1,578,950,000,  the trust will also issue $40,485,901.75 initial principal amount of certificates. If the aggregate initial principal amount of notes  is $1,842,110,000, the trust will also issue $47,233,590.15 initial principal amount of certificates. If the aggregate initial principal  amount of notes is $2,105,270,000, the trust will also issue $53,981,282.38 initial principal amount of certificates.
